back: The story goes that Descartes thought of coordinates while watching a fly on the ceiling. Your phone's map dot is the same idea.

title: Where the distance formula comes from
back: PR and RQ are the differences of the coordinates; PQ is the hypotenuse. It is the Pythagoras theorem.

title: Distance from the origin
back: $(-6,8)$ is 10 units from the origin; $(5,12)$ is 13.

title: Dividing a segment in m : n
back: P divides AB internally so that AP : PB = m : n. Each ratio part multiplies the far end.

title: Section formula
back: $m$ multiplies the second point, $n$ the first.

title: Midpoint
back: The section formula with ratio $1:1$. The centre of a circle is the midpoint of a diameter.

title: Finding an unknown ratio
back: On the x-axis put $y=0$; on the y-axis put $x=0$.

title: Square or rhombus?
back: Sides first, then diagonals. Equal diagonals also turn a parallelogram into a rectangle.

title: Fourth vertex of a parallelogram
back: Diagonals bisect each other, so the two midpoints are the same point.

title: Three points on one line
back: The two shorter distances add up to the longest. (The area formula is not in boards.)
